entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Caecilius of Elvira (b. 100 CE) was a Roman entrepreneur and business leader of the Late Antique period, active in the Roman province of Hispania. He is known for his involvement in the Christianization of the Roman Empire and his role in the spread of early Christianity in the Iberian Peninsula.

As a key figure in the early Christian church, Caecilius of Elvira played a significant role in the development of Christian doctrine and practice. He was a prominent bishop and theologian, and his writings on Christian theology and ethics had a lasting impact on the early Christian church.

Caecilius of Elvira's legacy extends beyond his own lifetime, as he helped shape the course of Christian history in the Western world. His influence can be seen in the development of the Catholic Church and the spread of Christianity throughout Europe during the Middle Ages.

'In Christ, I have found my true self,' Caecilius of Elvira once said, reflecting the profound impact he had on the early Christian church.
